notes.title: Patch 1.2.2.1
notes.content:
Changes:

 reduced catch requirement for the "rare fish" from 1000 to 200.

notes.title: V1.2.2
notes.content:
Changes:

After a certain amount of catches ([spoiler]1000 catches[/spoiler]), the rare fish becomes a guaranteed catch.


The rarest fish is no longer as elusive as it once was! after some realization on my part that some play to 100% the game, 1/1000 chances of catching the "rare fish" seemed a little less than fair. to combat this, I've decided to make this RNG element a little less RNG-y...

notes.title: x64 build version
notes.content: added a new build for x64 windows operating systems rather than just having the x32 build.

notes.title: V1.2.1!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753550/237f4d69188f2c4ae6abd4a5285b9ede16984d02.png

Update 1.2.1 is just a small patch.

Things fixed:

 fixed flicker when screen-sharing via discord.
 fixed specific achievement not triggering properly. ([spoiler]'A beautiful sight' now triggers when flower is fully grown, found thanks to @travismaynard![/spoiler])

Hope you enjoy!


P.S. I tinkered around with a resizable window, though it was more trouble than it was worth as I never had that in mind when originally creating the game and ran into many problems from what I tried. Apologies for not getting it added, It's something I'll have to keep in mind with future projects.

notes.title: V1.2!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41753550/237f4d69188f2c4ae6abd4a5285b9ede16984d02.png

Update 1.2 is a small one, but it was a very "I should add these things".

Things added:

 Added new rare fish
 remodeled upstairs (yes, with a bed/nest too!)
 added camera scroll when outside
 added achivements!
 added some small details (and secrets)

While it's nothing major, hope you all enjoy!
